tutorial.title: Z-index
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to move elements in front or behind other elements.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent: Let's learn how to control overlapping game HUD and sprites.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
We'll start off with a background sprite and a HUD label below it. Set the sprite's width to 300px.

Make sure to pick width followed by : and then 300px, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
Setting a sprite to position: absolute removes it from the normal flow. That's why the sprite overlaps the HUD text.

Make sure to pick position followed by : and then absolute, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can control how sprites overlap with a property called z-index. Set z-index to 0, its default value.

Make sure to pick z-index followed by : and then 0, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
Because all elements have their z-index set to 0 by default, the browser puts the sprite in front because it's the first element in the HTML.

Make sure to pick 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
To place an element behind another, we set z-index to a lower number. In this case, code -1.

Make sure to pick -1.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
Any whole number works. Place the player class sprite in front of the other sprite by setting the z-index to 1.

Make sure to type 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
Elements with a higher z-index number are always in front. Set the third sprite's z-index to 2 to make it overlap the first two sprites.

Make sure to type 2.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the default z-index value for elements?

01

Make sure to pick 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this code display?

A background image behind a level titleA level title behind a background image

A background image behind a level title.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this code display?

The sprite of class player in front of another spriteThe sprite of class player behind another sprite

The sprite of class player in front of another sprite.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which elements are in front of other elements?

The elements with a higher z-index numberThe elements with a lower z-index number

The elements with a higher z-index number.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the baseline value of z-index: 0;.

Make sure to pick z-index followed by : and then 0, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Place the background behind the HUD by setting z-index to -1.

Make sure to type -1.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Place the sprite of class player on top of any other sprites.

Make sure to pick 2, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Place the element of class player in the middle of the other two sprites.

Make sure to type 1.
